readme.overview: Hotjar module allows you to assign Hotjar Site Id for a Store and get insights about the shopping behaviour of your users with Heatmaps, Recordings, Feedback and etc.

notes.forAnalyst: Session recording and heatmaps, so someone can watch how shoppers actually behave.
notes.forArchitect: A thin bridge: one dependency, three settings, no storage. Its footprint is a script on the storefront, which makes it a privacy decision more than an architectural one.
notes.forDeveloper: Recording sessions captures whatever is on screen — mask fields before enabling it, and treat this as personal-data processing.
reachForItWhen: UX questions need observation rather than numbers
A funnel drop-off has no obvious cause
doNotReachForItWhen: Consent and masking have not been designed
You need aggregate metrics — analytics is cheaper and less invasive
The question is server-side: this sees only the browser
